_purpose: Prove that generic Smart+ hierarchy enrichment changes identity fields only and preserves shared-social delivery grain and metrics.

custom_checks.name: smart_plus_rows_exist
custom_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM {table} AS candidate JOIN (SELECT CAST(creative_id AS STRING) AS ad_id FROM `giant-spoon-299605.tiktok_ads_adif.creative_history` WHERE campaign_automation_type = 'UPGRADED_SMART_PLUS_CREATIVE' QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY creative_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC, _fivetran_synced DESC) = 1) AS smart_plus USING (ad_id) WHERE candidate.source_relation = 'tiktok_ads_adif'

custom_checks.name: smart_plus_hierarchy_complete
custom_checks.sql: SELECT COUNTIF(NULLIF(candidate.campaign_id, '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(candidate.ad_group_id, '') IS NULL) AS value FROM {table} AS candidate JOIN (SELECT CAST(creative_id AS STRING) AS ad_id FROM `giant-spoon-299605.tiktok_ads_adif.creative_history` WHERE campaign_automation_type = 'UPGRADED_SMART_PLUS_CREATIVE' QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY creative_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC, _fivetran_synced DESC) = 1) AS smart_plus USING (ad_id) WHERE candidate.source_relation = 'tiktok_ads_adif'
